plain_text:
HEADING BACK TO YOUR WORKPLACE SOON? Here are some tips from the National
Institutes of Health and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for staying safe
during COVID-19. Always be sure to check the latest CDC and local guidelines.
semantic_text: HEADING BACK TO YOUR WORKPLACE SOON? Here are some tips from the National Institutes of Health and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) for staying safe during COVID-19. Always be sure to check the latest CDC and local guidelines.

plain_text:
Getting a COVID-19 vaccine
will help protect you and your
co-workers. You are considered
fully vaccinated either two weeks
after your second dose of the
Moderna or Pfizer vaccines, or two
weeks after your single dose of the
Johnson & Johnson vaccine.
semantic_text: Getting a COVID-19 vaccine will help protect you and your co-workers. You are considered fully vaccinated either two weeks after your second dose of the Moderna or Pfizer vaccines, or two weeks after your single dose of the Johnson & Johnson vaccine.

plain_text:
When in-person meetings are necessary, they
should be held in open, well-ventilated spaces.
semantic_text: When in-person meetings are necessary, they should be held in open, well-ventilated spaces.

plain_text:
Be prepared and ask about your organization's
COVID-19 requirements before returning to
work. Some workplaces may still require things
like masks or other respirators even for fully
vaccinated people.
semantic_text: Be prepared and ask about your organization's COVID-19 requirements before returning to work. Some workplaces may still require things like masks or other respirators even for fully vaccinated people.

plain_text:
It's always important to follow
health best practices at work.
So continue to avoid touching
your nose, mouth, and eyes. In
addition, avoid sharing work
equipment, such as phones and
desks, unnecessarily. Frequently
clean and disinfect touched
objects and surfaces.
semantic_text: It's always important to follow health best practices at work. So continue to avoid touching your nose, mouth, and eyes. In addition, avoid sharing work equipment, such as phones and desks, unnecessarily. Frequently clean and disinfect touched objects and surfaces.
